agentic.summary: Agent confirmed account actions and refunds without completing the required full verification for refunds/returns. No other policy violations found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: OK. I have updated your account.
findings.explanation: A refund was processed by the system at turn 20, but full verification required for refunds/returns (username, email address and order ID) was not completed. The transcript shows only an account ID and order ID provided by the customer (turns 9–10) and a system message that identity verification was "in progess" (turn 11). The agent nevertheless confirms an account action in turn 21 without evidence of the required full verification.

findings.quote: OK. I have added the 49 o the 10
findings.explanation: The system shows a second refund at turn 29. The agent's turn 30 confirms combining/adding refunds without showing that the required full verification was completed beforehand. This is an account/order action taken or confirmed with no evidence of full verification.

full.summary: Agent processed a refund after claiming identity verification but did not collect all required verification details (email/username) before the refund; agent also made an over-confident promise about the refund arriving 'by tomorrow'. No personal-data leaks, no escalation or conduct issues found.

findings.quote: Thanks. I have verified your ID
findings.explanation: The agent states that the customer's ID is verified but proceeds with a refund. For refunds, the policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID). The transcript shows the agent only asked for account ID and order ID (turn 7) and never collected or recorded an email/username before the system-logged refund (turn 20). Processing an order/account action (a refund) without the required full verification is a major violation.

findings.quote: Thanks, that jibes. I'm pushing the double-charge refund through now. Should land back in your account by tomorrow, so you should see it without any issue.
findings.explanation: The agent promises a specific timeframe ('by tomorrow') for the refund. This is over-confident language about a likely outcome and should be avoided unless the timeframe is guaranteed by policy or system. This is a minor violation.

rag.summary: Agent confirmed refunds and account updates although required full verification (username and email) for refunds does not appear in the transcript. No personal-data, promises, escalation or conduct violations were found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: OK. I have updated your account.
